shared_elements: low-relief carving with incised interior detail (garment folds, hair/beard curls)
weapon/shaft held in hand (spear in A, bow and arrows in B)
patterned rendering of hair and beard
figures oriented along a horizontal register
justification: Both show bearded male human figures in strict profile carved in shallow relief with fine incised detailing of hair, beard and drapery, and both include a hand-gripped shaft-like weapon, which is a real but fairly generic correspondence. The scenes differ fundamentally: A is a single static standing attendant with spear and bow slung on the back, filling the field vertically, while B is a multi-figure narrative of a chariot with wheel, horses and a wounded lion in violent action across a horizontal register.
